blurb: Guests enjoy private charters on a 24' pontoon boat with a licensed captain. Options include visiting Haulover Sandbar, exploring hidden islands, or cruising Biscayne Bay to see Miami sights and wildlife. The boat accommodates up to 10 guests and includes amenities like a cooler, floating mat, and Bluetooth speaker.
